name: switch-17
description: Smart home device cards with per-room power switches and live status.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Fan as FanIcon, Heater as HeaterIcon, Lamp as LampIcon, Tv as TvIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Switch } from "@workspace/ui/components/switch" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const devices = [ { id: "lamp", name: "Desk lamp", room: "Designali studio", icon: LampIcon, on: true, }, { id: "fan", name: "Ceiling fan", room: "Meeting room", icon: FanIcon, on: false }, { id: "tv", name: "Review display", room: "Design room", icon: TvIcon, on: false, }, { id: "heater", name: "Space heater", room: "Office", icon: HeaterIcon, on: true, }, ] export default function SmartHomeDevices() { const [power, setPower] = React.useState(() => Object.fromEntries(devices.map((device) => [device.id, device.on])) ) const activeCount = Object.values(power).filter(Boolean).length return (

{activeCount} of {devices.length} devices on

{devices.map((device) => (

{device.name}

{device.room}

setPower((p) => ({ ...p, [device.id]: checked })) } aria-label={device.name} />
))}
) }
